summaries.title: Flow-GRPO: Training Flow Matching Models via Online RL
summaries.perspective:
本研究聚焦于**训练与强化学习**（Training & RL）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「强化学习信用分配困难与训练不稳定性」痛点，作者围绕 **Flow-GRPO** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖群组相对策略优化（Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)）、流匹配（Flow Matching），并引入 Ordinary
Differential Equation (ODE), Stochastic Differential Equation (SDE) 等关键机制。核心论点主张：We propose Flow-GRPO, the first method integrating online reinforcement learning (RL) into flow matching models。
